title: INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) profile integration: canary, back-compat, and rollback playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Integrate INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) into the main inference runtime CI and production rollout pipeline. Establish deterministic canary gating, validate backward compatibility against pinned model versions and legacy tokenization/decoding paths, and publish an operational rollback playbook that QA, SRE, and SEs can run with minimal blast radius.
acceptance_criteria: A1: CI job 'quant-int8-eval' runs on every profile change and fails the PR if top-line metrics regress beyond the established guardrail (perplexity/dialog-accuracy thresholds).
A2: Canary rollout path implemented: 0->1->5->25% traffic phases with automated quality checks at each phase and automatic halt on regression.
A3: Backward compatibility tests cover tokenization, sampling seeds, and deterministic generation for pinned checkpoints; any divergence is flagged with a classification (benign, suspect, breaking).
A4: Rollback playbook vetted with SRE and on-call: runbook includes quick commands to re-pin model variant, disable prefix-caching, and force legacy kernel path.
A5: Regression dashboard (quant-int8/regressions) shows historical runs for GPTQ/AWQ profiles and is linked in the PR template.
tasks: Create a new CI stage 'quant-int8-eval' that runs a 500-sample eval set across GPTQ and AWQ profile families.
Add performance and quality thresholds to the CI stage, including latency SLO and top-k accuracy/perplexity deltas.
Wire canary traffic routing hooks into the rollout orchestration layer and add quality gates after each traffic step.
Author deterministic back-compat tests: tokenization round-trip, sampling-with-seed, and end-to-end golden prompts.
Produce the rollback playbook and verify with a simulated rollback drill in the staging environment.
Update PR templates and developer docs to require links to regression dashboard and eval artifacts when adding a new profile.
comments: 2026-01-08 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff meeting notes — agreed on a small deterministic eval set (500 prompts) covering chat, completion, and code snippets. Decided to treat GPTQ and AWQ as separate profile families with shared CI job.

2026-01-20 - Rohit Patel: Implemented prototype CI stage. Early runs show AWQ profiles have 0.6% perplexity delta vs fp16 baseline on the golden set; need to define pass/fail threshold. Added threshold proposal to PR.
2026-02-02 - Lina Zhou (SRE): Reviewed rollout hooks. Recommended adding a quick 'force-legacy' flag to the canary runner to reduce risk during rollback. Assigned follow-up to Rohit.

2026-02-25 - Rohit Patel: Added back-compat tests for tokenization edge-cases (Unicode combining, long sequences). Found 1 failing case related to subword boundary handling in legacy tokenizer switch — filed ENG-11442 to fix tokenizer shim.

2026-03-05 - QA (Marcus Lee): Ran simulated canary with traffic ramp to 25% in staging. Canary halted automatically at 5% due to sampling-seed divergence classification 'suspect'. Investigation suggests KV cache warmup timing differences; added cache-warmup mitigation to tasks.
2026-03-10 - Ava Martinez: Draft rollback playbook pushed to Confluence. Next step: tabletop run with on-call and product to validate communications and SLAs.
resolution_plan: If CI fails on a profile change: block merge and require a detailed regression artifact comparing current vs baseline outputs with diff-tool outputs.
If canary gate fails in production: immediately pause rollout, trigger automatic scale-back to previous model variant, run quick determinism checks, and open an incident channel.
If a backward-compatibility test fails in a benign mode: file a follow-up engineering ticket and include risk assessment score before continuing rollout.
notes_for_reviewers: Please check the proposed CI thresholds in PR #4821 and comment on whether the 1.0% perplexity and 0.5% top-k accuracy windows are acceptable for P1 releases.
Security: no new key material is introduced by these profiles. Confirm that profile blobs are scanned by existing SBOM pipeline.
